---
title: "What is the trimmed flight time at the optimised geometry?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 90.0
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0
PROBE_POOL = 200.0
PROBE_SPENT = 17.7

import aerosandbox as asb
import aerosandbox.numpy as np

min_sink = optimize_geometry_for_sink_rate(get_airplane)
flight_time = 1.5 / min_sink
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"No, {flight_time:.2f} s"`]{.hero-value}
[Trimmed flight time from 1.5 m]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Even with geometry fully freed to find the lowest possible sink rate, the aircraft cannot achieve the 2.0 s flight-time target. The minimum trimmed sink rate is [`{python} f"{min_sink:.2f} m/s"`]{.key} (from [how low can trimmed sink rate be driven with free geometry and ballast?](2026-09-29-01-how-low-can-trimmed-sink-rate-be-driven-with-free-geometry-and-ballast.qmd)). From a 1.5 m standing throw, this yields a flight time of [`{python} f"{flight_time:.2f} s"`]{.key}.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from IPython.display import display, Markdown

table = f"""
| Configuration | Trimmed sink rate | Flight time from 1.5 m |
|---|---|---|
| Baseline (unballasted) | 1.89 m/s | 0.79 s |
| Optimised geometry | {min_sink:.2f} m/s | {flight_time:.2f} s |
"""
display(Markdown(table))
```
